itens.trecho: Interessante, criativo, mas com falhas menores. Este filme gira em torno do roubo de ideias, levado ao limite, com o ladrão a entrar na mente de outra pessoa através de um sonho feito para esse propósito.
Ariadne: "Why is it so important to dream?" Cobb: "Because, in my dreams we are together." I haven't seen this movie in years, but after re-watching it struck me hard how depressing this was.
Whether you watch Inception as a heist movie, a redemption story, or a sci-fi action picture, Christopher Nolan's tour de force of dreams will absolutely work its magic over you.
